function: CSI feedback: a universal UE encoder compresses downlink CSI into a codeword and cluster-specific BS decoders reconstruct it, trained by clustered federated learning (pp. 1, 4).
system: Downlink CSI feedback, 32-antenna BS, single-antenna UE, CSI cropped to 32x32 in the angular-delay domain; COST2100 indoor/outdoor and QuaDRiGa at 0.8/2.4 GHz; no RIS (pp. 3, 10).
method: Autoencoders (CsiNet in Setup 1, VQ-VAE-based VQCINet in Setup 2) trained by clustered federated learning CFL-GP: spectral clustering of gradients, universal encoder, per-cluster decoders (pp. 6, 9, 15).
data_channel: Setup 1: COST2100 indoor and outdoor, 50,000 samples each; Setup 2: eight QuaDRiGa datasets (0.8/2.4 GHz, urban micro/macro, LOS/NLOS), 10,000 training and 10,000 test samples each (pp. 9-10).
test_conditions: Trained and tested on the same contexts: COST2100 with 8/16/32 contexts and 32-128 bits; eight QuaDRiGa contexts at 64-256 bits with held-out test samples (pp. 9-10).
baselines: No non-learned baseline. Learned: global model (K=1), local models (K=C), CsiNet centralized results of [4], clustered FL algorithms IFCA [27] and MADMO [28] (pp. 8-9, 11).
metrics: NMSE in dB, cosine similarity, codebook perplexity, clustering accuracy by adjusted Rand index, intra-cluster NMSE gap (max-min fairness), training and transmission cost (pp. 8-13).
complexity: FLOP complexity of the autoencoder is 5.58M, 5.68M and 5.88M for 64, 128 and 256 bits; Table 1 gives training and transmission cost formulas (pp. 8, 16).
q1_support: p. 8: "We use the COST2100 Channel Model Dataset [4]"; p. 10: "using QuaDRiGa (QUAsi Deterministic RadIo channel GenerAtor) [29], [30]"
q2_support: p. 10: "each comprising 10,000 training samples and 10,000 test samples"; p. 13: "the handling of entirely new channel distributions that have not been previously observed". Not met: tests use held-out samples of the same contexts, and unseen contexts are left as future work.
q3_support: p. 8: "The scheme that utilizes a single global model corresponds to setting K to 1 in the proposed algorithm". Not met: no non-learned CSI feedback method (codebook, compressive sensing) is compared; baselines are variants of the method (global K=1, local K=C), CsiNet results of [4], IFCA and MADMO.
q4_support: p. 16: "The FLOP complexity of the autoencoder is 5.58M, 5.68M, and 5.88M"
q5_support: p. 3: "We open-source both the algorithm implementation and the complete dataset [9]"; link on p. 16 (ref. 9): https://github.com/Heasung-Kim/clustered-federated-learning-to-support-context-dependent-csi-decoding
notes: Area 2 (CSI feedback), not 7: federated learning here is digital model averaging between BSs and a central unit (pp. 4, 6), with no over-the-air aggregation, and the learned model is the CSI autoencoder. q1: both COST2100 and QuaDRiGa are used. q2: unseen contexts are future work (p. 13). q3: the Centralized [4] column of Table 2 reuses published CsiNet results (p. 9), a learned method; no non-learned method is compared. The COST2100 test split is not described in the text.
